message: 渋さの境地

name: Helena
message: 「You're nothing more than a puny, wimpy daikon sprout!! Calling yourself the Demon Lord is as big a crime as pouring Worcestershire sauce on tofu and calling it chilled tofu!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Begone from this Ryuusei Town forever!!」
Ah, to think I'd imagine a scene like this. It just goes to show how unfit I am to be the Demon Lord.
At this rate, a new Demon Lord will appear in my place--

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... A new Demon Lord has arrived! All the chicks with huge tits belong to yours truly!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nooo, help meee!」

name: Helena
message: 「He's gonna have his way with meee!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop iiit!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Why, if it isn't the fake Demon Lord. If you cooperate with yours truly, how about I share half of this beefsteak with you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh. Using that as leverage is playing dirty...」

name: Ria
message: 「Getting tempted by a reward--you really are the worst, fake!」

name: Helena
message: 「Someone like you can just go gnaw on beef tendon!」
I-If things actually played out like that, I'd be in serious trouble.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't go making yours truly the bad guy on your own.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy! I want to become a cool, slightly bad-boy kind of guy, so what should I do!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's got into you, all of a sudden.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I don't, forget about a sparkling school life--even this entire world will be in huge trouble!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Hold on a second? Speaking of cool, slightly bad-boy types, isn't that Helena's exact type.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Could it be, Mr. Demon Lord, you've got a thing for Helena? Kukuku... In that case, it gets a nuisance out of my way, so that's super convenient.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Geez, can't be helped. Yours truly will drill the ABCs of being a man into you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please teach me, Master Paqy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hellooo~」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Why are you facing away?」

name: Synn
message: 「A real man speaks with his back.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I see. Synn-kun, would you like something to drink?」

name: Synn
message: 「Coffee. Strong and black...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't have any, green tea, straight.」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Ria
message: 「Green tea that's not straight...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, enjoy♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Slurp... Delic--I mean, it moistens my body worn down by the hustle and bustle of the city... An exquisite taste.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I'm glad♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I demand a refill. You have no objections, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Do you know whose plastic bottle this is right here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tch, that bastard Nanaka. No matter how many times I tell him not to leave his trash and his heart behind, he never listens.」

name: Ria
message: 「There's nothing left in it, so I'll go ahead and throw it away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, plastic bottles don't go in the recycling. You throw 'em in the non-burnable trash.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I can't believe Synn-kun would do something like that...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right? Just goes to show I'm surprisingly bad to the bone.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~ I don't think you're quite that bad, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means I'm a little bit of a bad boy, right!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, don't break character!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, crap!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought Synn-kun was acting strange, so that's what was going on.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Weird?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you've been doing an impression of Paa-chan the whole time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!!」
Is that really all my rugged charm amounts to~~.

name: Ria
message: 「What's gotten into you? Starting to act like that all of a sudden really surprised me.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's... um...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Apparently he wants to be a rugged, slightly bad-boy type.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, hold on! Paqy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan is the one person I can't say no to. Sorry 'bout that, Demon Lord.」
What a disloyal familiar!!

name: Paqy
message: 「So yours truly took it upon himself to tutor him directly. Though if you compare yours truly to a whale, Synn-sama barely measures up to a wood ear mushroom.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not even a comparison...」

name: Ria
message: 「C-Could it be... no way... are you trying to match Big Sis's type?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, the dress rehearsal went off without a hitch. Now, let's move on to the real thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「What!? It was a total failure!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's head over heels for yours truly, so that couldn't be helped. Against Helena, though, it's an A-OK V-sign.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way I can pull that off~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Switch-on!」

name: Synn
message: 「Leave the rest to me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright! Go get 'em like you're stepping in front of a stray bullet!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph...」

name: Helena
message: 「Are you... imitating Paa-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... I'm finished...」
Farewell, my sparkling school life.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun... you really wanted your big sis to...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai. Thank you for going out of your way to humor me with this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh!? Oh, y-yeah. Sorry I couldn't be of any help...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. I knew from the very beginning that it wasn't for me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah. Pushing yourself too hard isn't good. But...」

name: Ria
message: 「But, you know! Even without forcing yourself, you're plenty charming, Synn-kun! I think you're best just the way you are!」

name: Ria
message: 「So... so... so, yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmph, you got this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't sweat it, Synn-sama!」
Relying completely on someone else is no good.
